description.value:
The Cut-o-Matic is the ultimate proof that weapons are nothing more than toys for adults. Its flashy design and menacing whirr of its blade make every Night City maniac fall in love at first sight. This unique piece has all the makings of a cult classic, but there's a reason its manufacturer has the word "Budget" right there in its name.

Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive)

Class: Heavy Melee • Skill: Melee Weapons • Range: Melee

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: N/A • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: None • Mods: None

Special Features: As an Action this weapon can be revved up. Once revved, it will remain so until dropped, stowed, or until revved down with another Action. While revved, this weapon is a One-Handed Very Heavy Melee Weapon which, whenever it would ablate armor, ablates 2 additional points of SP (3 SP Total). While revved, if this weapon rolls a 1 on an Attack Check, the motor fails and it automatically revs down.

Range: Melee

Foundry notes:

  • Listed capacity is N/A; the sheet tracks 0.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
